samples.question: The image shows one square panel enclosed by a coloured frame and ruled into a 9 by 9 grid of equal square cells. Every cell is printed in one flat shade of grey taken from six evenly spaced greys. Above the panel two key squares are printed in the same coloured outline, and each carries one of those six greys. Keep a cell when its grey lies in the closed band between the two key greys, that is when it is no darker than the darker key square and no lighter than the lighter key square; discard every other cell, whether it is darker than the darker key or lighter than the lighter key. The kept cells form one of these symbols: plus, square, chevron, ladder, arrow. Each symbol is drawn on a 7 by 7 block of cells that may sit anywhere inside the 9 by 9 panel. Match by sliding each symbol over the panel to the placement disagreeing with the kept cells in the fewest of the 81 cells, and take the symbol with the smallest such count. Which symbol do the kept cells form? Answer with one word.
